def get_by_id(client, id):
    """Retrieves a group by its ID.

    :param client: instance of
        :class:`mambu_client.client.MambuClient`
    :param id: ID of the group to retrieve
    :return: instance of :class:`mambu_client.model.group.Group`
    """
    return Group(client, id)
